name: Bágyogszovát (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of red over blue, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Bágyogszovát (a red and blue shield with a ploughshare, a wavy stripe and crossed tools, within a green wreath) below the name BÁGYOGSZOVÁT.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.
